cd ~/Developer/degen
gh auth switch -u shivinate7
merge 436 --confirm --base-red-ok "main's red milestone run 41747042457 is the DegenKit flakes and iOS 27 build gap that batch #428 fixes; #436 changes CI pins only"

context:
The merge tool refuses every degen merge (#436, then #428) because main's latest milestone run, 41747042457 (73f66dbf, 2026-11-03 18:28 CST), is red. It is red on the DegenKit flakes and the iOS 27 build gap that #428 fixes. #436 changes CI pins only.

Why yours: only your typed `--base-red-ok` lets a merge pass a red main (merge tool, 2026-11-03 18:04 CST). No session may type it for you.

The cd assumes your degen checkout is ~/Developer/degen; change it if not.
title: Type the red-main override to merge degen #436
